fact: Based on the 2021 Census and civil registry data, birth registration coverage in Cabo Verde was estimated at 108.6% for 2021, and 3.0% of children under five were unregistered at the census.
title: Assessment of inequalities in birth registration in Cabo Verde based on data from the 2021 Census
publisher: CRVS Research Forum 2026 (National Institute of Statistics, Cabo Verde)
